HxResult HxCreateDirectory ( const char *  dirname,
mode_t  mode 
)

Create a directory with implicitly calling HxStorageBeginWrite/EndWrite.

This function creates a directory by calling mkdir(2) internally. If the directory is on a removable storage volume, this function automatically calls HxStorageBeginWrite before creating a directory and calls HxStorageEndWrite afterwards.

Parameters:
dirname IN: Name of the directory to create
mode IN: Permission of the created directory
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxDeleteDirectory ( const char *  dirname  ) 

Delete a directory with implicitly calling HxStorageBeginWrite/EndWrite.

This function deletes a directory by calling rmdir(2) internally. If the directory is on a removable storage volume, this function automatically calls HxStorageBeginWrite before deleting a directory and calls HxStorageEndWrite afterwards.

Parameters:
dirname IN: Name of the directory to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxDeleteFile ( const char *  filename  ) 

Delete a file with implicitly calling HxStorageBeginWrite/EndWrite.

This function deletes a file by calling unlink(2) internally. If the directory is on a removable storage volume, this function automatically calls HxStorageBeginWrite before deleting a file and calls HxStorageEndWrite afterwards.

Parameters:
filename IN: Name of the file to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxFileClose ( FILE *  fp  ) 

Close a file stream and call HxStorageEndWrite.

This function closes a file stream by calling fclose(3) internally. If the file is on a removable storage volume, this function automatically calls HxStorageEndWrite for the volume index where the file locates.

Parameters:
fp IN: File stream pointer returned by HxStorageBeginWrite
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxFileOpen ( const char *  path,
const char *  mode,
FILE **  fpp 
)

Open a file stream after calling HxStorageBeginWrite.

This function opens a file stream by calling fopen(3) internally. If the file is on a removable storage volume, this function automatically calls HxStorageBeginWrite for the volume index where the file locates.

Parameters:
path IN: Name of the file to open
mode IN: Mode string used by fopen(3)
fpp OUT: Pointer to the File stream pointer returned by fopen(3)
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
